results.content: The day he took his second oath of office, YouGov’s weekly tracker put his favorable rating at 40.7 percent among independents, with an unfavorable level of 56.3 percent. As of the most recent incarnation of the poll, released July 13, the voting bloc had a 28.7 percent favorable rating and a 69.3 unfavorable level. [...] More than half (59 percent) of independents said they were either “very confident” or “somewhat confident” that the congressional elections in four months will be fair, according to a survey conducted last month by YouGov and The Economist.
